description: CRITICAL: Domain objects must know how to create themselves from their context. Objects should have creation methods that show what context/parameters they need, rather than delegating creation to other objects. Self-creation methods belong to the object being created.

content: Objects know how to create themselves from context
Creation methods show what context/parameters are needed
Self-creation methods belong to the object being created
Factory methods for selection belong to registry/selector, not created object
Creates from rule and context: Rule
(Violation knows how to create itself from rule and context)
Creates from file and AST node: File, ASTNode
(Block knows how to create itself from file and AST)
(Scan knows how to create itself for a scope and rule)

dont.description: Don't delegate object creation to other objects
content: Don't have other objects create domain objects
Don't delegate creation to external factories
Don't hide creation logic in unrelated objects
(Scan should create itself, Scanner selects/uses it)
- Objects delegating creation to other objects
- Creation methods on objects that don't logically create the target
- External factories creating domain objects instead of self-creation
- Creation logic hidden in unrelated domain objects
Factory methods for SELECTION belong to registry/selector:
